description: Ground transport on HotelsCasa, with the right link to start: "taxi" — order a taxi or transfer (pre-filled with origin, destination, passengers, luggage and time when given); the fare is set by the taxi company and shown before ordering. "shipment" — send a parcel, furniture, a move or freight in the city, across the country or internationally on the transport exchange: publish the job without a price and carriers make offers; the sender picks one. "car_rental" — rent a car from owners and rental fleets. These services are growing city by city; the page shows what is available where the traveller is. Always give the traveller the url of every item as a clickable link, unchanged: it is the only way to book or buy.

lang.description: Language of the links: es, en, de, fr, it, pt, tr, ru, pl, no, lv, lt, et, fi, sr or bg. Default es.

shipment_scope.description: Shipment distance: same city, within the country, or abroad.

when.description: Taxi pickup time, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM). Omit for now.
